plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Orbit uses your location to track time at places you name in a goal, like the library. Friends only see places you choose to share.

plugins.contactsPermission: Orbit matches your contacts' emails and phone numbers to find friends who are already on Orbit. Contacts aren't stored or messaged.

plugins.photosPermission: Orbit lets you pick photos to share with friends and for your profile picture. It never scans your library.

plugins.calendarPermission: Orbit reads when you're free or busy so it can suggest times to catch up with friends. Event details stay private.
